import sys

MOD = 1000000007
maxn = 8
SZ = 1048576 + 5

def inc(a, b):
    return (a + b) % MOD if (a + b) < MOD else (a + b - MOD)

def dec(a, b):
    return a - b if a >= b else a + MOD - b

def mul(a, b):
    return (a * b) % MOD

def power(x, k):
    tmp = 1
    while k:
        if k & 1:
            tmp = mul(tmp, x)
        x = mul(x, x)
        k >>= 1
    return tmp

n = int(input())
a = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
inv100 = power(100, MOD - 2)
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        a[i][j] = mul(int(input()), inv100)
for i in range(n + 1, 7):
    a[i][i] = 1

num = [[[0] * 7 for _ in range(7)] for _ in range(7)]
cnt = 0
for i in range(1, 7):
    for j in range(i + 1, 7):
        for k in range(j + 1, 7):
            num[i][j][k] = 1 << cnt
            cnt += 1

all = (1 << cnt) - 1
g = [[0] * maxn for _ in range(maxn)]
p = [0] * (1 << 21)
dfs1(1, 1, 1)

for j in range(cnt):

        if i & (1 << j):
            p[i] = inc(p[i], p[i ^ (1 << j)])

def dfs1(now, x, y):

        return

                        sta |= num[X][Y][Z]
        p[sta] = inc(p[sta], now)

    g[x][y] = 1

def check(x, y, z):

    return False

def next_permutation(iterable):
    iterable = list(iterable)
    for i in range(len(iterable) - 2, -1, -1):
        if iterable[i] < iterable[i + 1]:
            break
    else:

    for j in range(len(iterable) - 1, i, -1):

    iterable[i + 1:] = iterable[i + 1:][::-1]
